description: EMBOSS 6.6.0 featcopy: every feature table of a file in ANY input format is read by the feature readers of the EMBOSS library and written in an output format. Input formats: embl, genbank, refseq (nucleotide, feature lines of five blanks), genpept, refseqp (protein), gff2 (versions 1 / 2, ##Type, ##sequence-region, group fields, featflags), gff3 (ID / Parent grouping, several lines of one ID, percent-encoded values, several tables), the gff3 EMBOSS wrote before 6.4, swiss, pir, dasgff (XML); with no format the library tries embl, refseq, refseqp, genpept, gff3, gff2, swiss, pir and dasgff in turn on the start of the file and keeps the first that finds features, and a 'format::' prefix of features forces one (an unknown name is an error message and the formats are tried). Output formats written for a feature table: gff3 (gff, unknown input = refused as the program does), gff2, embl (em), genbank (gb, ddbj), debug (the full internal trace: type, source, score, strand, positions, flags, group, exon, tags, sub-features); bed, refseq, refseqp, pir, swiss, dasgff and draw are not written for a feature table by this port. The first table is cut to the range featureBegin / featureEnd (a table with a range is trimmed and its features shifted: a feature cut at the end is flagged). The reader and writer pairs equal the installed program on 3 800 input files (embl, genbank, refseq, genpept, refseqp, gff2, gff3, gff3emboss, swiss, pir, dasgff: 236 or more each, damaged and mixed files, the format:: prefix, ranges, the files on which the program never stops are refused with an error) and 1 800 output files in gff3 / gff2 / embl / genbank and their aliases; the messages (Warning: bad /protein_id value ..., Error: Unknown input format ...) are returned as the program prints them.

features.description: The text of the feature file (a feature table of any input format, or an EMBL / GenBank entry; several tables may follow one another).

featuresValue.description: The value of -features: 'format::' prefix and [begin:end] suffix are read as the program reads them; default the file itself.

outputFormat.description: The output feature format (-offormat): gff3 (default), gff, gff2, embl, em, genbank, gb, ddbj, debug.

featureBegin.description: -fbegin: the first table is cut to this range start (default 1; negative counts from the end).

featureEnd.description: -fend: the first table is cut to this range end (default: its length).

fileName.description: The name of the output file (the value of -outfeat without a format:: prefix).

text.description: The feature tables in the output format.

format.description: The output feature format as the program resolved it.

tables.description: The number of feature tables written.

messages.description: What the library printed on its error stream (Warning: ..., Error: ...), in order.

errors.message: Invalid arguments (an empty feature file, a file that no feature reader reads - 'Bad value for -features and no more retries' -, an output format this port does not write for a feature table, an input on which the reference program never stops).
